set.body:
Outcome

Admit an exact image4s revision whose image4s-locus bridge has been verified against the same locus4s API revision used directly by ScalaFIM.

External prerequisite

Complete image4s task bd-01KZ6B8P1DH6YGT7KMYNB9YV3H. That task itself admits the provider produced by locus4s epic bd-01KZ6B4SF3BS6YH7SHEERM9V6H.

Work

- Record exact image4s and locus4s commits and the image4s-locus JVM/Scala.js receipts.
- Update ScalaFIM pins without implicit sibling resolution.
- Inspect resolution so direct and transitive locus4s dependencies converge on one API revision.
- Compile a focused GridDomain/Field/registry consumer probe before VolumeDomain migration.

Acceptance

- ScalaFIM resolves one compatible locus4s revision through both direct and image4s paths.
- The exact provider evidence and dependency closure are attached.
- Focused JVM and Scala.js bridge probes pass.
- Failure blocks VolumeDomain migration rather than permitting local copies or version skew.
set.title: Admit a locus4s-aligned image4s-locus revision into ScalaFIM
